In the online A/B test, GenRec shows an **average treatment effect of +0.115%** on the short-term homepage engagement metric, relative to the production model. The **p-value is 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁰**, and the result is marked as statistically significant. (Page 6, Figure 3)

Some related context from the same page:
- For comparison, the long-term core metric showed +0.006% with P = 0.025, also significant. (Page 6, Figure 3)
